value.rationale: Period tuning by cubic velocity damping for a well-studied self-sustained hybrid oscillator is a natural dynamical observable not determined by limit-cycle existence/algebraicity. The all-amplitude sign is a non-obvious quadratic energy identity involving deformation of the orbit; the precise Hopf-end scale is an independent quantitative boundary invariant. Neither statement is a textbook sign check or arbitrary coefficient slice: beta=1 is the exact algebraic-circle locus.
